text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further by checking how different parts of the system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, which means writing tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps catch problems early and keeps the design simple. Most importantly, good testing gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they can change the code without fear of breaking something. In short, testing saves time, reduces stress, and leads to more reliable software.
